title: GSD 2: Autonomous CLI Agent for Software Engineering
summary: An autonomous CLI-based agent designed to automate complex software engineering workflows using state-managed task decomposition. It manages git operations, context windows, and verification loops to enable reliable hands-off development.
research_notes: Surpassed 62,000 GitHub stars across its ecosystem and is distributed via the gsd-pi npm package.

evolution.summary: Transitioned from a legacy prompt framework to a standalone supervisor-level CLI built on the Pi SDK. Recent updates added state reconciliation, drift detection, and automated workspace lifecycle management.
